question: In a certain code language, ‘Min Fin Dig Jig’ means ‘Radha is an artist’ and ‘Sic Ric Min Dig Fin’ means ‘An artist is always open-minded’. Which of the following is the code for ‘Radha’?
solution:
The logic followed here is:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/360dc1fd57e3a7038177cdb982489f8df64c83022b6881bf6ab4e86dba56b3f9.png]
